    {"id": "IRQ-LEVEL", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A high-level source sets its `PENDING` bit at every rising edge where its input is high."},
    {"id": "IRQ-EDGE", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A rising-edge source sets its `PENDING` bit at a rising edge where its input is high and was low at the previous rising edge, so an input held high sets it once."},
    {"id": "IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "Detection does not depend on `ENABLE`: a disabled source still sets its `PENDING` bit."},

    {"id": "IRQ-ACK", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CLAIM` acknowledges the source whose number is in `wdata` bits 4 to 0: that source's `PENDING` bit clears and no other bit changes; a number of `N` or more changes nothing."},
    {"id": "IRQ-SET-WINS", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A source detected at the same rising edge as a write that clears its bit keeps its `PENDING` bit set, so a high-level source acknowledged while its input is still high stays pending."},
    {"id": "IRQ-MASK", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "`irq` is high exactly when some source has both its `PENDING` and its `ENABLE` bit set, for high-level and rising-edge sources alike."},
    {"id": "IRQ-PRIORITY", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "`irq_id` is the lowest-numbered source whose `PENDING` and `ENABLE` bits are both set, so source 0 has the highest priority, and it is 0 while `irq` is low."},
    {"id": "IRQ-CLAIM", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A read of `CLAIM` returns `irq` in bit 31 and `irq_id` in bits 4 to 0, with every other bit zero."},
    {"id": "IRQ-LATENCY", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "`irq` and `irq_id` follow the registers with no clock edge, so a source detected at one rising edge drives `irq` until the next."}

    {"id": "t_param_sweep", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-PARAM", "IRQ-PRIORITY", "IRQ-ACK"], "description": "Goal: the block works across N. Check: the scoreboard compares rdata, irq and irq_id every cycle against the model."},
    {"id": "t_read_no_side_effect", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-READ"], "description": "Goal: reads are combinational and side-effect free. Check: rdata matches the selected register within the same cycle, with no edge, and all registers are unchanged after the reads."},
    {"id": "t_level_detect", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-LEVEL"], "description": "Goal: level sources set pending on every high edge.     {"id": "t_edge_detect", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-EDGE"], "description": "Goal: edge sources set pending once per rise.     {"id": "t_detect_disabled", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED", "IRQ-MASK"], "description": "Goal: detection ignores ENABLE.     {"id": "t_w1c", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-W1C"], "description": "Goal: write-1-to-clear semantics. Stimulus: create random pending patterns with sources quiet, then write random masks to PENDING, including all-zero and all-ones. Check: new PENDING equals old AND NOT mask, and no bit is ever set by a write."},
    {"id": "t_ack", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-ACK"], "description": "Goal: CLAIM write acknowledges one source. Stimulus: all bits pending, sources quiet.     {"id": "t_set_wins", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-SET-WINS"], "description": "Goal: set wins over clear at the same edge. Stimulus: at the same rising edge, detect source i and either W1C its bit or acknowledge it via CLAIM. Cover both level mode with the input held high and edge mode with a rise on that edge. Check: PENDING[i] remains 1 after the edge."},
    {"id": "t_mask", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-MASK"], "description": "Goal: irq equals OR of PENDING AND ENABLE. Stimulus: random ENABLE, MODE and source activity, mixing level and edge sources. Check: every cycle, irq == |(PENDING & ENABLE), using register values from a reference model."},
    {"id": "t_priority", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-PRIORITY"], "description": "Goal: lowest enabled pending id wins. Stimulus: multiple pending sources with varied enables, acknowledging the winner repeatedly. Check: irq_id is the lowest index with PENDING&ENABLE, a pending but disabled lower source is skipped, and irq_id is 0 whenever irq is low."},
    {"id": "t_claim_read", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-CLAIM"], "description": "Goal: CLAIM read format. Stimulus: read addr 3 with no interrupt, with interrupts on several ids including N-1, and with irq low but pending disabled sources. Check: rdata[31]==irq, rdata[4:0]==irq_id, bits 30..5 are 0."},
    {"id": "t_latency", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-LATENCY"], "description": "Goal: irq and irq_id are combinational from the registers. Stimulus: a source detected at edge k, and ENABLE written at edge k. Check: irq and irq_id are valid right after edge k, before edge k+1, and change in the same cycle as the register update with no extra cycle."},
    {"id": "t_random_regression", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-REG-RW", "IRQ-LEVEL", "IRQ-EDGE", "IRQ-W1C", "IRQ-ACK", "IRQ-SET-WINS", "IRQ-MASK", "IRQ-PRIORITY", "IRQ-CLAIM"], "description": "Goal: stress all features together. Stimulus: constrained-random writes to all four addresses, random source toggling, and random mode changes over many seeds. Check: the cycle-accurate reference model scoreboard compares rdata on all addresses plus irq and irq_id every cycle."},
    {"id": "a_claim_format", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-CLAIM"], "description": "When addr==3, rdata == {irq, 26'b0, irq_id}. Port-level; checked in simulation over all tests."},
    {"id": "a_id_zero_when_idle", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-PRIORITY"], "description": "!irq implies irq_id == 0."},
    {"id": "a_mask_via_reads", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-MASK"], "description": "Using shadow copies of ENABLE and PENDING that the bind module samples from the testbench model, irq == |(pending & enable) every cycle."},
    {"id": "a_upper_bits_zero", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-PARAM"], "description": "When addr is 0, 1 or 2 and N<32, rdata[31:N] == 0."},
    {"id": "a_ack_out_of_range", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-ACK"], "description": "With all sources low and in level mode, a CLAIM write with wdata[4:0] >= N leaves the PENDING value, as read through addr 2 on the next cycle, equal to its prior value."},
    {"id": "a_irq_id_in_range", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "proves": ["IRQ-PRIORITY", "IRQ-LATENCY"], "description": "irq implies irq_id < N. irq and irq_id are stable between clock edges while addr, src and wdata change (no combinational dependence on src)."}
  ]
